layeredTravelTime.reference: quake-sim IASP91 layer table frozen CPU result

jmaThreeComponent.reference: JMA frequency weighting and 0.3 s duration rule

applicability.dc3d: Homogeneous isotropic elastic half-space; rectangular dislocations; no layering, plasticity, landslide or poroelastic response.
applicability.nlswe: Hydrostatic long waves; no dispersion or wave breaking; wet/dry accuracy depends on terrain resolution and threshold.
applicability.travelTime: Direct upgoing ray in a simplified 1-D IASP91 table, not a full regional 3-D tomography solution.
applicability.jmaThreeComponent: Requires calibrated acceleration in gal and adequate sampling/duration; synthetic inputs are not observations.
applicability.responseSpectrum: Linear elastic SDOF, constant 5 percent damping unless explicitly changed.
